title: Enterprise identity and tenant-admin proof: move SSO/RBAC/tenant boundaries from configured-state to enforceable truth
goal: Close the gap between visible enterprise identity settings and enterprise-ready access control by proving or explicitly gating browser SSO, tenant membership, role enforcement, session expiry/logout, and SCIM/tenant-admin boundaries.
scope: Build the next governed identity proof slice on top of the existing OIDC/SAML settings and RBAC foundations. The task should add enforceable or clearly blocked operator paths for tenant membership and role boundaries, browser-session enforcement where configured, session expiry/logout behavior, and SCIM/tenant-admin status. Local development fallback may remain for dev mode but must not be presented as enterprise authentication.
generation_reason: Enterprise readiness still lists OIDC/SAML browser enforcement, SCIM, tenant membership, and hosted RBAC as gaps. The product needs an explicit proof task after foundation work instead of leaving these as vague future work.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Enterprise identity enforcement proof only. Do not weaken ROE, scope boundaries, API-key revocation, tenant isolation, or local development safety labels.

success_criteria: Enterprise mode clearly distinguishes dev fallback from enforced browser identity and blocks misleading enterprise-ready claims when SSO is only configured but not enforced.
Tenant membership and role boundaries are enforced or explicitly marked blocked with next actions in Settings/Diagnostics.
Session expiry/logout behavior has API and browser/UI proof and does not corrupt active missions or runs.
SCIM/invitation/tenant-admin status is surfaced honestly with configured, disabled, or unsupported states and no plaintext secrets.
Audit events capture identity/admin changes and access-boundary decisions.

acceptance_criteria: Enterprise identity readiness does not imply SSO enforcement unless enforcement is proven.
Tenant/admin/RBAC limits are visible, tested, and audit-backed.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Removing local development fallback without a separate migration task
